{| align="right"
|{{Wotmonth|Saven}}
|}'''Saven''' is the sixth month in the [[Farede calendar]]. In most years, it is equivalent to the real world period from [[May]] [[May 11|11]] to [[June]] [[June 7|7]].  [[Feast of Fools]] occurs during Saven (everywhere but [[Arad Doman]] and the [[Borderlands]]) and [[Dahan]] on the 9th.
